A new popular character has been added to Zootopia: Better Zoogether! at Disney's Animal Kingdom
Take a peek behind the scenes as our story lead shares some of the latest updates coming to "Zootopia: Better Zoogether!” at Disney’s Animal Kingdom, including a first look at Mayor Brian Winddancer from "Zootopia 2"! 🐴
